scope.claim: Every statically resolvable fixed repo-relative write to a tracked path under the roots is named by either this manifest or check-derived-artifacts.py GENERATORS.

unenumerated.name: dynamic-sinks
unenumerated.reason: User-selected --out, args.out, output and manifest paths are resolved only at invocation time; the scanner does not guess which tracked path a caller may choose.

unenumerated.name: temporary-probe-and-kat-sinks
unenumerated.reason: Temporary directories, gen-out products, run directories and /tmp probe/KAT files are not committed artifacts and are intentionally outside the ownership union.

unenumerated.name: manual-and-non-script-sinks
unenumerated.reason: Hand-edited files and writers outside scripts/**/*.py or scripts/**/*.sh are not inferred; AxiomSweep.lean is listed explicitly below, while any other such writer needs a reviewed row.

unenumerated.name: uncommitted-reports
unenumerated.reason: PROGRESS.md is intentionally generated on demand and uncommitted, so it has no committed owner row.

owners.name: axiom-witnesses
owners.reason: The witness module is generated from the three progress registries and checked before the kernel axiom reports are trusted.

owners.name: drift-ledger
owners.reason: DRIFT.md is the committed rendered TCB ledger and must match the registry-derived report.

owners.name: rv64-shims
owners.reason: The generator rewrites only the dependency re-export shim family; the bounded glob covers the generated files without claiming all Rv64 modules are generated.

owners.name: axiom-baseline
owners.reason: The whole-library axiom baseline is written by the Lean executable, not by a Python or shell writer; its report-only CI check is the owner.

owners.name: import-metrics-baseline
owners.reason: The import-graph cost ratchet compares this checked-in baseline and rejects unexplained regressions.

owners.name: olean-weights
owners.reason: This dependency/toolchain pricing snapshot is refreshed deliberately after a build; the current --check path consumes the baseline but does not claim freshness for weights.

owners.name: axiom-allowlist
owners.reason: Only reviewed pre-existing trust-axiom owners may remain in this allowlist; the axiom gate reads it on every build.

owners.name: axiom-witness-registry-floor
owners.reason: The independent witness-name floor prevents a registry shrink from shrinking both sides of the axiom comparison.

owners.name: code-preimage-empty-hash-floor
owners.reason: The allowlist pins known status-5 violations while the source gate checks the empty-code identity and rejection polarity.

owners.name: orphan-block-snapshot
owners.reason: The linked-ELF CFG snapshot distinguishes reviewed known-open orphans from newly introduced unreachable blocks.

owners.name: duplication-baseline
owners.reason: The calibrated jscpd budget is an advisory quality-trend gate rather than a verifier claim, but its baseline still needs an owner.

owners.name: transcription-issues-snapshot
owners.reason: The issue snapshot is refreshed from GitHub deliberately; the queue's deterministic doc check consumes this committed snapshot and makes stale output visible.

owners.name: asm-fixture-manifest
owners.reason: The conversion manifest is a reviewed registry of Function-to-source bindings; asm-to-program checks its rows and fixture bijection.

owners.name: asm-to-program-coverage
owners.reason: The coverage report is a human-facing census generated on demand; no CI check currently regenerates this report, so freshness is explicitly not claimed.

owners.name: div-operands-sample
owners.reason: This is a deliberately reviewed research sample, not a verifier input or CI ratchet.

owners.name: div-weights
owners.reason: The tool accepts a caller-selected --weights path; this row records the tracked research snapshot without pretending every invocation targets it.

owners.name: guest-image-floor-source
owners.reason: The deliberate floor update rewrites two constants in the generator itself; the coverage gate consumes those constants and rejects a drop.
